sources.title: OpenAI raises $122 billion to accelerate the next phase of AI

event.title: OpenAI funding round (March 2026)
event.summary: OpenAI closed a funding round with $122 billion in committed capital at an $852 billion post-money valuation, co-led by SoftBank with a16z, D. E. Shaw Ventures, MGX, TPG and accounts advised by T. Rowe Price. OpenAI also expanded its revolving credit facility to about $4.7 billion.

participants.note: Accounts advised by T. Rowe Price Associates, Inc.
Continued participation as a long-term partner
Named as Fidelity Management & Research Company

amounts.label: Committed capital
amounts.quote: Today, we closed our latest funding round with $122 billion in committed capital at a post money valuation of $852 billion.

amounts.label: Post-money valuation
amounts.quote: Today, we closed our latest funding round with $122 billion in committed capital at a post money valuation of $852 billion.

amounts.label: From individual investors through bank channels
amounts.quote: For the first time, we extended participation to investors through bank channels, raising over $3 billion from individual investors.

amounts.label: Revolving credit facility (expanded, undrawn at close)
amounts.quote: We have also expanded our existing revolving credit facility to approximately $4.7 billion, which gives us added flexibility as we continue to invest at scale.

facts.label: Anchor investors
facts.text: Amazon, NVIDIA and SoftBank anchored the round, and Microsoft continued to take part.
facts.quote: The round was anchored by our strategic partners Amazon, NVIDIA, and SoftBank, with continued participation from our long-term partner, Microsoft.

facts.label: Co-leads
facts.text: SoftBank co-led the round with a16z, D. E. Shaw Ventures, MGX, TPG and accounts advised by T. Rowe Price Associates, Inc.
facts.quote: SoftBank co-led the round alongside a16z, D. E. Shaw Ventures, MGX, TPG, and accounts advised by T. Rowe Price Associates, Inc.

facts.label: Other named investors
facts.text: Altimeter, Appaloosa LP, ARK Invest, affiliated funds of BlackRock, Blackstone, Coatue, D1 Capital Partners, Dragoneer, Fidelity Management & Research Company, Goanna Capital, Insight Partners, The Paragon Group, Sands Capital, Sequoia Capital, Sound Ventures, Temasek, Thrive Capital, UC Investments (University of California CIO Office) and Winslow Capital.
facts.quote: There was also significant participation from a diverse set of global institutions including Altimeter, Appaloosa LP, ARK Invest, affiliated funds of BlackRock, Blackstone, Coatue, D1 Capital Partners, Dragoneer, Fidelity Management & Research Company, Goanna Capital, Insight Partners, The Paragon Group, Sands Capital, Sequoia Capital, Sound Ventures, Temasek, Thrive Capital, UC Investments (University of California CIO Office), and Winslow Capital.

facts.label: ARK Invest ETFs
facts.text: OpenAI said it will be included in several exchange-traded funds managed by ARK Invest.
facts.quote: Today, we're also announcing that OpenAI will be included in several exchange-traded funds managed by ARK Invest, further broadening ownership and giving more people the opportunity to share in the upside economics of OpenAI and the AI era.

facts.label: Credit facility lenders
facts.text: JPMorgan Chase, Citi, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Wells Fargo, Mizuho, Royal Bank of Canada, SMBC, UBS, HSBC and Santander.
facts.quote: The facility is supported by a global syndicate including JPMorgan Chase, Citi, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Wells Fargo, Mizuho, Royal Bank of Canada, SMBC, UBS, HSBC, and Santander.

facts.label: Credit facility undrawn
facts.text: The credit facility was undrawn at close.
facts.quote: The facility remains undrawn at close.

relations.note: The $110 billion announced on February 27, 2026 from SoftBank, NVIDIA and Amazon is part of this round.
OpenAI says it expanded its existing revolving credit facility. The $4 billion facility of October 2024 is counted in the expanded amount.
